name: Summated phase-current relay input
summary: Connects the assigned phase-current quantities to the selected summation measurement function.
description: Connects the assigned phase-current quantities to the selected summation measurement function. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase current quantities” at the input and “Summated current quantity” at the output. Calculated summation differs from a separate sensor.
